title: 2.1.2 2D Shapes and Transforms
description: Create 2D primitives and apply transforms to build compositions.

steps.title: Create 2D shapes
hints: circle({ radius: 8 }) creates a circle with radius 8

steps.title: Apply transforms
steps.instructions: Use `transforms.translate([x, y], shape)` and `transforms.rotate([0, 0, angle], shape)` to position your shapes.
hints: translate moves a shape. The first argument is [x, y] for 2D.
rotate takes radians. Math.PI / 4 is 45 degrees.

steps.title: Return multiple shapes
steps.instructions: Return an array of shapes from main(): `return [shape1, shape2, shape3]`

requirements.title: Create a 2D shape
requirements.description: Use at least one 2D primitive (rectangle, circle, ellipse, polygon, star)

requirements.title: Use translate
requirements.description: Move at least one shape using transforms.translate

requirements.title: Use rotate
requirements.description: Rotate at least one shape using transforms.rotate

requirements.title: Return multiple shapes
requirements.description: Return an array containing multiple shapes from main()

requirements.title: Use two different primitive types
requirements.description: Create shapes from at least 2 different primitive functions
